questions.prompt: After the reset, which commit does main point to?
What happened to soup.md on disk?
options: Nothing; the salt line is still there and now shows as an unstaged change
It was rewritten to match the older commit, so the salt line is gone
It was deleted, because the commit that changed it was undone
It is now staged for the next commit

questions.prompt: What happened to the commit "Add salt to soup"?
options: It still exists in the repo, but no branch points to it, so the log no longer lists it
It was deleted from disk immediately
It moved to a new branch called HEAD
It was merged into the previous commit
